operators.name: custom_batchnorm2d_forward
semantics: Performs BatchNorm2d inference: y = (x - running_mean) / sqrt(running_var + eps) * weight + bias
Normalization is per-channel (dim=1); running_mean and running_var have shape [in_features].
Broadcasting: running_mean, running_var, weight, bias are reshaped to [1, C, 1, 1] and applied to x of shape [N, C, H, W].
Uses the provided eps from BatchNorm2d (default 1e-5).
Output has same shape, dtype, device as input x.

operators.name: custom_log_softmax_dim1_forward
semantics: Performs LogSoftmax along dimension 1: y[n,c,h,w] = x[n,c,h,w] - log(sum_{c'} exp(x[n,c',h,w]))
Normalization is over the channel dimension (dim=1) for each spatial and batch location.
Numerically stable computation: subtract max over dim=1 before exp and log-sum-exp.
Output has same shape, dtype, device as input x.
BatchNorm2d in eval mode uses stored running_mean and running_var, weight, bias, eps.
Output is normalized tensor of shape [512, 16, 64, 64], float32, CUDA.
LogSoftmax along dim=1 applied to normalized tensor.
Output is log-probabilities tensor of same shape, float32, CUDA.
Final return is the log-softmax output tensor of shape [512, 16, 64, 64], float32, CUDA.
